decisive_items: Viral resistance testing showed mutations in UL97 (C592G) and UL54 (N408K) genes
Ulceration of the glans penis noted during treatment course
response.rationale: Rising CMV viral load with UL97/UL54 resistance mutations in an immunocompromised host directly indicates active CMV infection; other candidates are historical or less specific, and PCP is contradicted by CT findings.

rejected.why: CT shows no consolidations or ground-glass opacities, arguing against PCP.
MAC is historical and not supported by current imaging or symptoms.
IRIS is possible but less specific than documented CMV viremia and resistance mutations.
Bronchiectasis is a background condition, not the acute presentation.
